name: Varinkio – Print Shop Configurator for WooCommerce
author: Geeth Senadheera

sections.description:
Varinkio helps print shops configure and sell print products through WooCommerce without relying on a single fixed product price.

Create flexible print products with quantity-based pricing, attribute combinations, artwork upload and live customer pricing — all managed directly inside WordPress.

Varinkio includes two product configuration modes:

  • Quantity Mode for products sold at predefined quantity price breaks.
  • Attribute Matrix Mode for products priced from combinations of attributes and quantities.

For larger pricing tables, Varinkio includes a built-in Price Generator and CSV import/export tools. Generate matrix prices automatically, export a ready-made CSV template, edit pricing in a spreadsheet, and import the completed matrix back into WordPress.

Varinkio also includes product option groups, artwork upload, Product Builder mappings, server-side cart price validation, a customer account portal, a custom order confirmation layout, and store-branded WooCommerce email styling.

There are no product-count quotas in the free plugin. Quantity Mode and Attribute Matrix Mode can be used with unlimited mapped WooCommerce products.

Varinkio key features

  • Unlimited Quantity Mode products.
  • Unlimited Attribute Matrix products.
  • Quantity price breaks for fixed print quantities.
  • Attribute Matrix pricing for combinations such as paper type, printed sides, finishing and quantity.
  • Built-in Price Generator to automatically create or update matrix prices.
  • Generate pricing using Multiplier, Base + Increment, or Fixed Price methods.
  • CSV matrix import for quickly adding or updating large pricing tables.
  • Exportable CSV templates ready for spreadsheet editing.
  • Attribute groups and values with card or dropdown display options.
  • Matrix cloning and testing tools.
  • Additional product option groups with configurable pricing.
  • WooCommerce Product Builder mapping for Simple WooCommerce products.
  • Customer artwork upload with configurable file types and maximum upload size.
  • Live frontend configuration and pricing.
  • Server-side price verification before configured products enter the cart.
  • Customer account dashboard, order history, addresses, account settings, and support.
  • Custom WooCommerce order confirmation page.
  • Store-branded WooCommerce email header and footer styling.
  • Appearance, account, artwork, email, and support settings.
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.

Varinkio Pro

Varinkio Pro builds on the free edition with additional tools for print shops that need measurement pricing, quotations and more advanced customer workflows.

Pro features include:

  • Measurement Mode for custom width × height print products.
  • Dynamic measurement pricing engines.
  • Material-based measurement product configuration.
  • Customer quote request system.
  • Guest quote requests with secure account claim flow.
  • Saved Quotes area in the customer portal.
  • Quote approval and decline workflow.
  • Customer replies and communication within quote requests.
  • Artwork upload for quote requests.
  • Quote-to-order checkout conversion.
  • Admin quote management.
  • Custom customer login, registration, lost-password and reset-password pages.
  • Extended appearance, branding, quote, artwork, support and advanced settings.

Varinkio Pro is distributed separately from the WordPress.org version.

Privacy and external services

Varinkio does not send store, customer, order, pricing, or artwork data to Varinkio servers or another remote API.

Uploaded artwork is stored on the site’s own WordPress uploads directory under uploads/varinkio/artwork.

The plugin contains links to the separate Varinkio Pro product in relevant WordPress admin screens. Those links are only opened when an administrator clicks them.

Store owners can optionally configure their own website, live-chat, logo, phone, email, and support links. Any third-party service used through a store-configured link is controlled by the store owner and is not contacted automatically by Varinkio.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the varinkio folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Varinkio.
  4. Go to Varinkio > Product Types and create a Quantity or Attribute Matrix product type.
  5. Configure quantity prices or attribute matrix prices as required.
  6. Use Varinkio > Product Builder to map a Simple WooCommerce product to the Varinkio product type.
  7. Configure optional product options, artwork settings, appearance, customer account, email, and support settings.
  8. Open the WooCommerce product on the front end and test its configuration, cart price, artwork upload, checkout, and order confirmation flow.
sections.faq:
Does Varinkio require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is a required dependency.

Which product modes are included?

This plugin includes unlimited Quantity Mode and Attribute Matrix Mode products.

Is Measurement Mode included?

No. Custom width-by-height Measurement Mode is not included in this plugin. It is available separately in Varinkio Pro.

Does the plugin limit the number of Quantity or Attribute Matrix products?

No. Both included product modes can be mapped to unlimited WooCommerce products.

Can customers upload artwork?

Yes. Store owners can configure permitted artwork file extensions and the maximum upload size. Artwork is stored on the site’s own WordPress uploads directory.

Does Varinkio trust a price submitted by the browser?

No. Cart prices are recalculated and verified on the server from the stored Varinkio configuration before they are applied to WooCommerce cart items.

Does Varinkio send data to an external service?

No. The plugin does not automatically send customer, order, artwork, or configuration data to an external Varinkio service.

What happens if I later use Varinkio Pro?

Varinkio and Varinkio Pro are separate plugins and should not run at the same time. Shared Varinkio configuration is retained when changing editions, including data used by Pro-only functionality.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed product gallery thumbnail and previous/next navigation behaviour.
  • Improved gallery isolation from theme image and button styles.
  • Improved compatibility with Shoptimizer and themes that use WooCommerce summary hooks for layout wrappers.
  • Prevented duplicate WooCommerce product gallery, price and add-to-cart content on block themes.
  • Preserved normal product description/details and related products below the Varinkio configurator.
  • Expanded WordPress.org feature documentation for the Price Generator, CSV tools and Varinkio Pro.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Unlimited Quantity Mode products.
  • Unlimited Attribute Matrix products.
  • Product Builder, product options, and artwork upload.
  • Customer account and order confirmation layouts.
  • Store-branded WooCommerce email styling.
  • Server-side cart price verification.
